name: apex-key-remapping
description: Key remapping service for the Apex Pro Gen 3, implemented twice: ASP.NET Core and TypeScript serverless.

scripts.postman:test: npx --yes newman run postman/apex-key-remapping.postman_collection.json -e postman/local.postman_environment.json --folder 'Scenario — the brief, end to end'
scripts.//catalog: Most workspaces import @apex/hid-catalog, which resolves to its dist/ output. dist/ is gitignored, so a fresh checkout has the workspace symlink and nothing behind it. Building it here means no caller — script, workflow or person — has to remember.
